outcome: NOT PLAYABLE - blocked by a content defect

attempts.detail: scripts/playthrough/battle_driver.py start reached native preparation successfully (the six-member cap-14 party was built and verified in the run state), then the native agent battle lifecycle refused the trainer: gEcAgentBattleResult = 3 (EC_AGENT_BATTLE_BAD_TRAINER), gEcAgentBattlePhase stayed IDLE, no decision point in 80000 frames.

strategy_checks.check: Plusle/Minun Plus+Minus shared special-attack boost while both are active
Helping Hand chosen only when it beats two attacks
Minun Light Screen / Encore only against a relevant threat
Volbeat priority Tail Glow converted into Bug Buzz damage
Illumise priority Encore / Helping Hand in the firefly mode

content_defects.summary: TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1 materializes with .partySize = 0 while carrying .poolSize = 4 and a full four-member party body, so the trainer fights with an EMPTY party in the compiled ROM.
evidence: src/data/trainers.party, TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1 block: header line 'Party Size: 0' immediately followed by SPECIES_PLUSLE / SPECIES_MINUN / SPECIES_VOLBEAT / SPECIES_ILLUMISE.
src/battle_setup.c CreateNPCTrainerPartyFromTrainer(): 'monsCount = trainer->partySize' then generates monsCount mons, so monsCount == 0 produces no battle party.
src/emerald_champions_agent_battle.c StartRequestedBattle() correctly rejects it via 'GetTrainerStructFromId(trainerA)->partySize == 0' -> EC_AGENT_BATTLE_BAD_TRAINER.
content_defects.reproducible: Yes. 'python3 scripts/emerald_champions_teams.py --write' regenerates src/data/trainers.party byte-identically, so this is a live materialization defect, not a stale checkout.
content_defects.scope: Exactly one trainer in the whole file. A scan of src/data/trainers.party found TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1 is the only block that has both 'Party Size: 0' and a SPECIES_ body; the other 148 'Party Size: 0' blocks are correctly retired metadata-only stubs with no party.
content_defects.suspected_root_cause: scripts/implement_emerald_champions_master_battles.py implement() stamps 'Party Size: 0' onto retired trainers (replace_attribute(header, 'Party Size', '0')) but rewrite_trainer_block() never resets 'Party Size' when a design is (re-)implemented. A trainer that was retired in one pass and re-authored in a later pass keeps the stale 0.
content_defects.owner: trainer-teams / materialization side; not repaired here (outside this playtest agent's edit scope, which is level offsets only).

cooler_note: The authored Plusle/Minun + Volbeat/Illumise twin concept is already a good early-route idea (two different paired-ability modes on one trainer). Suggestion for a later pass, not applied here: give Illumise Struggle Bug or Baton Pass so the firefly mode can hand Volbeat's Tail Glow boost somewhere, which would make the second mode a real engine instead of a softer copy of the rodent mode.
authored_set_legality: Not verifiable in battle. On paper the four members, abilities, items and moves are all legal for the cap-14 window.
not_finished: The E0014 battle itself is unplayed. It must be replayed once the partySize defect is repaired and re-materialized.
